body:
Also, see: "Represent a recall
RecallSegmenter.segment turns a transcript into a checked RecallGraph. The graph contains the original transcript, its source atlas, ordered recall units, recalled entities, coreference links, and explicit temporal or causal relations.

This guide uses the same recall as the alignment guide:

One of the men with him got hit by an arrow and they lifted him into the boat.

" -- a user might want to know how it does all that. This would be a good place to explain how. Beautifully and lucidly. If not here, in antoher section where we can link to here, so users can understand the science.
